info.title: ToOpen Non-Encrypted APP_KEY API
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1 document for the toopen endpoints when called through the APP_KEY path. Send `Authorization: Bearer <APP_KEY>` to bypass the SM4 request/response encryption branch in `app/common/middleware/UserDecryption.php`.

servers.description: Public toopen proxy. The gateway may strip the internal /toopen route prefix.
Local/internal Webman route prefix from route/toopen.php.

post.summary: 获取当前 APP_KEY 账号算力

appKeyBearer.description: Use `Authorization: Bearer <APP_KEY>`. With this header, UserDecryption uses the APP_KEY branch and does not SM4-encrypt request or response bodies.

GenericSuccessOrNone.description: Standard success response. Some status endpoints return string `none` when no running record exists.

StringData.description: Standard success response carrying a string value.

NumberData.description: Standard success response carrying a numeric value.

PaginatedData.description: Standard success response carrying a paginated service result.

ChunkedWorkflowStream.description: Chunked workflow stream. Each chunk is a JSON object string.

integral.description: 算力，由鉴权/计费中间件注入时可省略.

user_integral.description: 用户当前算力，由鉴权/计费中间件注入时可省略.

integral_title.description: 算力标题，由鉴权/计费中间件注入时可省略.

uid.description: 用户 ID. Usually injected from APP_KEY context.

website_id.description: 站点 ID. Usually injected from APP_KEY context.

ReferenceUrls.description: Reference media URLs or material IDs. Controllers require this to be an array when present.

Resolution123.description: 1=480p/720P family, 2=720p/1080P family, 3=1080p/2K family depending on endpoint.

images.description: 产品图片/上级历史 ID.

file_type.description: 素材类型, e.g. image, video, audio.
